Here’s your message rewritten to feel natural and intimate — like something you’d send late at night to the man you’re falling for. It keeps your tone and meaning, but flows like a real conversation between two people who already have chemistry and deep mutual respect:  

---

**Text:**  
> I’ve been thinking about what you said last night. I’ve always had soft men in my life — ones who let me take the lead — and it left me feeling a little unsteady without even realizing it. You’re the first man who’s been strong enough to match me, and I didn’t know how much I needed that until now. You’ve got this calm power that doesn’t have to be loud, but it still makes me pay attention and respect you in ways I never have before.  
>  
> The truth is, I think my nonchalant way with men came from never really having a reason not to be. But now I get it. I see what real boundaries look like, and why they matter. I’m not saying I’ve been out doing anything wrong, but the way you explained it made sense. I understand now that a real man carries himself differently — and deserves a different kind of respect in return.  
>  
> With that said, please give me some grace as I learn how to move through this with you. I might mess up here and there, but I promise I’m trying. Just correct me in private, with kindness and that same quiet authority that makes me feel safe, seen, and yours.  

---
